statements: create table kv(k integer primary key, v text, n integer)
with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i+1 from c where i < 200) insert into kv select i, 'init-' || i, i from c
update kv set v = 't1-' || k where k between 1 and 10
update kv set v = 't2-' || k where k between 1 and 5
delete from kv where k between 20 and 25
update kv set n = n + 1000 where k between 100 and 105
